summary.headline: Defense of Equal Houses
summary.text: Defense of equal twelve-part divisions of the zodiacal orb, following Ptolemy and ancient astrologers, against Neoteric house systems that merge signs or extend one sign across multiple houses. The discussion concerns house influences, the primum mobile, fixed and wandering stars, the Solar way, and the obliquity of the zodiac as the cause of worldly mutations, generations, and corruptions.
